$comment: The high-level map of Dam Good Maps' roadmap for the roadmap canvas. Only structure lives here (which steps exist, their lane, tag, branch, PRs and what they follow); everything that changes comes from ROADMAP.md, docs/STATUS.md, PLAN.md, git tags and GitHub when extract.mjs runs. Add a card when ROADMAP gains a step; the Health view lists sections, tags and STATUS rows no card covers.

process.summary: How a change travels from Kyler's decision to the live site, and how the documents record it.

nodes.title: Kyler decides
nodes.text: Every decision is recorded once in PLAN.md §20 with the next free D-number; superseded ones move to docs/archive/decisions.md. Defaults a session chose while Kyler was away sit in docs/decisions-pending.md until he overrules or accepts them.

nodes.title: ROADMAP orders the work
nodes.text: ROADMAP.md holds the open steps in one order (the release gate, then the post-release list, then the rest) with what each delivers and what blocks it. Finished steps move verbatim to docs/archive/roadmap.md.

nodes.title: Sessions build on branches
nodes.text: The milestone session (Opus 5.5) builds the core, water and generator; the page session (Fable 5.1) builds the page; the renderer session builds moving water and renderer R1. Each works in its own worktree and branch; Codex builds investigations on investigation/<name>.

nodes.title: A PR into dev, green
nodes.text: Nothing merges into dev red (D341). CI runs the quick suite, byte checks on generated maps, the retired-terms check and the determinism smoke. A docs-only change skips the heavy jobs.

nodes.title: Kyler's eye
nodes.text: Acceptance covers only what a player would notice or what would break (D115). Visual work is judged from captures against docs/PERFECT.md; probe batches play maps in the real game.

nodes.title: Tag <step>-done
nodes.text: A step Kyler approves is tagged on its green dev commit. Released steps' tags: git tag -l '*-done'.

nodes.title: Merge into main, deploy, live check
nodes.text: tools/release.sh opens a PR from the tag into main, merges it as a merge commit, watches the GitHub Pages deploy and the live check. If the live check fails, the release merge is reverted.

nodes.title: STATUS and the Progress log
nodes.text: docs/STATUS.md is rewritten at every step and stop (no history); every finish, release, batch or park gets a comment on issue #57; living docs are updated in the same PR (D188).

sideFlows.label: Codex: investigation/<name> → merged as an investigation at a boundary → Kyler's verdict → adopted into src/ (or not)
Anything Kyler finds in the water or the editor's core blocks the release until fixed (D385)
